```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE, fig.width = 10, fig.height = 5)
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = here::here())
```

Robustness of the trajectory model of the paper, the penalised
regression spline with REML smoothness selection (`spec_main` of `spline_functions.R`: `mgcv::gam(VAF ~ s(Age, k = 10),
method = "REML")`, k at most the number of timepoints), with the figures and tables of the supplement
(Figures S3-S5, Tables S2-S4):

1. nine `smooth.spline()` settings against REML (hold-out error, per-trajectory statistics,
   gene order, Fabre correlation, clusters);
2. a read-count bootstrap (95% intervals of the per-trajectory statistics);
3. the value given to the not detected timepoints (0, LoD/4, LoD/2, LoD, removed);
4. the cross-sectional screening calls added to the trajectories;
5. a simulation of clones with known fitness, sampled every 1 to 5 years and re-fitted with the REML spline and with the
   `smooth.spline()` `spar` = 0.2 spline;
6. one overview table of all sensitivity analyses.

Figures go to `figures/paper/` and to `output/Supplementary_Figures/`, tables to
`results/paper/`. Participant ids are the new ids of the paper (`SHCS_n`).

```{r libraries}
source("R/paper_functions.R")
library(dtwclust)
quick <- isTRUE(params$quick)   # a reduced run to test the code
n_seeds_cl <- if (quick) 2 else 30      # seeds of the consensus DTW clustering (the main clusters of the paper use 100)
B_boot <- if (quick) 5 else 200         # read-count bootstrap replicates
n_cores <- max(1, min(6, parallel::detectCores() - 1))
if (quick) {   # a test run writes nothing into results/, figures/ or output/
  scratch <- file.path(tempdir(), "sensitivity_quick")
  dir.create(scratch, showWarnings = FALSE)
  paper$supp <- scratch; rev$figures <- scratch; rev$results <- scratch
}
reml_col <- "#B2182B"
spar02_col <- "#2a78d6"
```

# 1. Data and the main analysis

```{r data}
calls <- load_calls()
ids <- load_ids()
lod_tbl <- calls %>% distinct(traj_id, lod = traj_lod_mean)
fabre <- load_fabre()
main_sum_saved <- load_sum()
main_clusters <- load_final_clusters() %>% select(traj_id, cluster)   # the final consensus clusters (k = n_distinct(cluster))
k_cl <- n_distinct(main_clusters$cluster)
traj_ids <- sort(unique(calls$traj_id))
label_tbl <- calls %>% distinct(traj_id, SHCS_ID_new, Gene.refGene, label) %>%
  mutate(panel = paste(SHCS_ID_new, label), gene = group_genes(Gene.refGene))

# the main analysis recomputed here: the same curves and statistics as resources/LoD/
main <- run_pipeline(calls, spec_main, lod_tbl)
chk <- inner_join(main$sum, main_sum_saved, by = "traj_id", suffix = c("", ".saved"))
stopifnot(nrow(chk) == length(traj_ids), isTRUE(all.equal(chk$mean_VAF_speed, chk$mean_VAF_speed.saved)),
          isTRUE(all.equal(chk$Age_0.02, chk$Age_0.02.saved)))

# clusters: the consensus over n_seeds_cl seeds of the REML curves, labels matched to the saved consensus (100 seeds)
cons_main <- cluster_consensus(main$pred, seeds = 1:n_seeds_cl, k = k_cl, ref = main_clusters)
j <- inner_join(cons_main$clusters, main_clusters, by = "traj_id", suffix = c("", ".saved"))
cat(sprintf("Main analysis: %d trajectories; consensus of %d seeds against the saved consensus of 100 seeds: ARI = %.3f\n",
            length(traj_ids), n_seeds_cl, adjusted_rand(j$cluster, j$cluster.saved)))
main$clusters <- main_clusters
main <- modifyList(main, setting_results(main, fabre))
cat("Gene order:", main$gene_order, "; Fabre r =", round(main$fabre$r, 3), ", p =", signif(main$fabre$p, 2), "\n")

# everything one setting produces (no SardiNIA refit here); the clusters are matched to the main clusters
run_setting <- function(spec, calls_in = calls, lod = lod_tbl) {
  res <- run_pipeline(calls_in, spec, lod)
  cl <- cluster_consensus(res$pred, seeds = 1:n_seeds_cl, k = k_cl, ref = main_clusters)
  res$clusters <- cl$clusters %>% select(traj_id, cluster)
  modifyList(res, setting_results(res, fabre))
}
result_cols <- c("setting", "trajectories", "same sign, mean speed", "same sign, mean acceleration", "same dynamics group",
                 "gene order", "same gene order", "Fabre r", "Fabre p", "cluster ARI", "same cluster")
```

# 2. Spline settings

## 2.1 Hold-out error

Each internal measurement is held out, the trajectory is fitted to the others with each setting and predicts it; the
error is divided by the VAF range of the trajectory. Linear interpolation between the two neighbours is the benchmark
(`select_spec()` of `spline_functions.R`).

```{r holdout}
sel <- select_spec(calls)
holdout_tab <- sel$criteria %>%
  mutate(`relative to the best` = median_err / min(median_err[setting != "linear"])) %>%
  transmute(setting = as.character(setting), `held-out points` = points, `median error` = median_err, `relative to the best`,
            `mean error` = mean_err, `median |error| / binomial SE` = median_abs_z, `median effective df` = median_df)
write_res(holdout_tab, "spline_holdout_errors.txt")
knitr::kable(holdout_tab, digits = 3, caption = "Out-of-sample error of held-out internal measurements (error / VAF range)")
```

## 2.2 Every setting against REML

```{r settings-run}
settings_A <- setdiff(names(spec_grid), spec_main_name)
# sequential: the DTW clustering does not survive a forked worker (mclapply), and a consensus of 30 seeds takes about a second
res_A <- lapply(settings_A, function(s) run_setting(spec_grid[[s]])) %>% set_names(settings_A)
stopifnot(all(map_lgl(res_A, ~ !inherits(.x, "try-error") && !is.null(.x$sum))))
cmp_A <- map_dfr(settings_A, ~ compare_results(res_A[[.x]], main) %>% mutate(setting = .x, .before = 1))
settings_tab <- bind_rows(tibble(setting = paste(spec_main_name, "(main)"), trajectories = length(traj_ids), `gene order` = main$gene_order,
                                 `same gene order` = TRUE, `Fabre r` = main$fabre$r, `Fabre p` = main$fabre$p, `cluster ARI` = 1,
                                 `same sign, mean speed` = 1, `same sign, mean acceleration` = 1, `same dynamics group` = 1, `same cluster` = 1),
                          cmp_A) %>%
  select(any_of(result_cols), starts_with("rho ")) %>%
  mutate(`clusters: seeds` = n_seeds_cl)
write_res(settings_tab, "spline_settings_comparison.txt")
settings_tab %>% select(any_of(result_cols)) %>% knitr::kable(digits = 3, caption = "Results of the paper by spline setting (against REML)")
```

```{r fig-rho, fig.width=12, fig.height=6}
rho_long <- function(cmp, by) {
  cmp %>%
    select(all_of(by), starts_with("rho ")) %>%
    pivot_longer(starts_with("rho "), names_to = "stat", values_to = "rho") %>%
    filter(!sub("^rho ", "", stat) %in% c("Age_zero", "Age_LoD")) %>%   # the paper uses two ages: at LoD/2 and at 2% VAF
    mutate(stat = factor(stat_labels[sub("^rho ", "", stat)], levels = rev(unname(stat_labels[setdiff(key_stats, c("Age_zero", "Age_LoD"))]))))   # reversed: first statistic on top
}
rho_heat <- function(d, by, title = NULL) {
  ggplot(d, aes(x = .data[[by]], y = stat, fill = rho)) +
    geom_tile(color = "white") +
    geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.2f", rho)), size = 3) +
    scale_fill_gradient2(low = "#2166AC", mid = "white", high = reml_col, midpoint = 0, limits = c(-1, 1), oob = squish,
                         name = "Spearman\nrho") +
    labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, title = title) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 13) + theme(panel.grid = element_blank(), axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1))
}
setting_levels <- c(names(spec_grid), "linear")
df_lab <- sel$criteria %>% transmute(setting = as.character(setting), lab = ifelse(is.na(median_df), "", sprintf("df %.1f", median_df)))
p_hold <- sel$errors %>%
  mutate(setting = factor(setting, levels = setting_levels)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = setting, y = err)) +
  geom_boxplot(aes(fill = setting == spec_main_name), outlier.size = 0.5) +
  stat_summary(fun = median, geom = "point", color = "black", size = 1.5) +
  geom_text(data = df_lab %>% mutate(setting = factor(setting, levels = setting_levels)), aes(x = setting, y = 1.05, label = lab),
            size = 2.6, angle = 90, hjust = 0) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("TRUE" = reml_col, "FALSE" = "grey90"), guide = "none") +
  scale_y_continuous(trans = "sqrt", limits = c(0, 1.6), breaks = c(0, 0.1, 0.25, 0.5, 1)) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "|error| / VAF range of the trajectory (sqrt scale)") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 13) + theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
p_rho <- rho_heat(rho_long(cmp_A, "setting") %>% mutate(setting = factor(setting, levels = settings_A)), "setting")
save_panel(p_hold, "supp", "FigS4_a_holdout", 6, 6)
save_panel(p_rho, "supp", "FigS4_b_spline_settings_heatmap", 7, 6)
p_settings <- (p_hold | p_rho) + plot_layout(widths = c(1, 1.3)) + plot_annotation(tag_levels = "a") & tag_theme
save_supp(p_settings, "FigS4_holdout_and_spline_settings", 12, 6)
p_settings
```

## 2.3 Four trajectories under every setting

```{r fig-examples, fig.width=13, fig.height=7}
# two trajectories by participant id and variant, then the two with the most timepoints
example_ids <- label_tbl %>%
  filter((SHCS_ID_new == "SHCS_7" & label == "TET2 p.H1219Y") | (SHCS_ID_new == "SHCS_6" & label == "DNMT3A p.K855Tfs*2")) %>%
  arrange(SHCS_ID_new != "SHCS_7") %>% pull(traj_id)
stopifnot(length(example_ids) == 2)
example_ids <- c(example_ids, calls %>% count(traj_id) %>% arrange(desc(n), traj_id) %>% filter(!traj_id %in% example_ids) %>% slice(1:2) %>% pull(traj_id))
stopifnot(all(example_ids %in% traj_ids))
panel_of <- label_tbl %>% filter(traj_id %in% example_ids) %>% mutate(traj_id = factor(traj_id, levels = example_ids)) %>% arrange(traj_id)
curve_levels <- c(VAF = "VAF", VAF_speed = "VAF speed (per year)", VAF_acceleration = "VAF acceleration (per year^2)")
ex_curves <- bind_rows(main$pred %>% filter(traj_id %in% example_ids) %>% mutate(setting = spec_main_name),
                       map_dfr(settings_A, ~ res_A[[.x]]$pred %>% filter(traj_id %in% example_ids) %>% mutate(setting = .x))) %>%
  select(setting, traj_id, Age, VAF, VAF_speed, VAF_acceleration) %>%
  pivot_longer(c(VAF, VAF_speed, VAF_acceleration), names_to = "curve", values_to = "value") %>%
  mutate(curve = factor(curve_levels[curve], levels = curve_levels), panel = factor(panel_of$panel[match(traj_id, panel_of$traj_id)], levels = panel_of$panel),
         setting = factor(setting, levels = names(spec_grid)))

  mutate(curve = factor(curve_levels["VAF"], levels = curve_levels), panel = factor(panel_of$panel[match(traj_id, panel_of$traj_id)], levels = panel_of$panel))
setting_cols <- c(setNames(c("#f4a582", "#92c5de", "#d1b26f", "#b2df8a", "#cab2d6", "#bdbdbd", "#969696", "#737373", "#525252"),
                           c("spar 0.1", "spar 0.2", "spar 0.3", "spar 0.4", "spar 0.5", "df 2", "df 2.5", "df 3", "df 4")), REML = reml_col)

p_ex
```

# 3. Read-count bootstrap

At every measured timepoint the variant reads are redrawn, alt ~ Binomial(depth, VAF); the imputed timepoints keep
LoD/2; the trajectory is refitted with the REML spline (`r B_boot` replicates). Per trajectory: 95% percentile intervals
and the share of replicates with the sign of the main analysis (robust when at least 95%).

```{r bootstrap}
boot <- bootstrap_stats(calls, B = B_boot, seed = 2026)
ci <- bootstrap_ci(boot, main$sum) %>%
  left_join(label_tbl %>% select(traj_id, SHCS_ID_new, gene), by = "traj_id") %>%
  select(traj_id, SHCS_ID_new, gene, stat, main, lo, hi, same_sign, robust, estimated)
write_res(ci %>% select(-gene), "trajectory_bootstrap_ci.txt")

gene_tbl <- main$sum %>% select(traj_id, Gene.refGene)
boot_genes <- boot %>%
  inner_join(gene_tbl, by = "traj_id") %>%
  group_split(b) %>%
  map_dfr(function(d) { fc <- fabre_cor(d, fabre); tibble(b = d$b[1], gene_order = gene_order(d), fabre_r = fc$r, fabre_p = fc$p) })
width_of <- function(st) { w <- ci %>% filter(stat == st) %>% mutate(w = hi - lo); median(w$w, na.rm = TRUE) }
boot_summary <- tibble(
  replicates = B_boot, trajectories = length(traj_ids),
  `mean speed: robust sign` = mean(ci$robust[ci$stat == "mean_VAF_speed"]),
  `mean acceleration: robust sign` = mean(ci$robust[ci$stat == "mean_VAF_acceleration"]),
  `max VAF: 95% interval width, median` = width_of("max_VAF"),
  `age at 2% VAF: 95% interval width, median (years)` = width_of("Age_0.02"),
  `age at LoD/2: 95% interval width, median (years)` = width_of("Age_LoD2"),
  `replicates with the main gene order` = mean(boot_genes$gene_order == main$gene_order),
  `Fabre r, median` = median(boot_genes$fabre_r), `Fabre r, 2.5%` = quantile(boot_genes$fabre_r, 0.025), `Fabre r, 97.5%` = quantile(boot_genes$fabre_r, 0.975),
  `Fabre p < 0.05, share of replicates` = mean(boot_genes$fabre_p < 0.05))
write_res(boot_summary, "bootstrap_summary.txt")
knitr::kable(boot_summary %>% pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "quantity", values_to = "value", values_transform = as.character), caption = "Read-count bootstrap")
boot_genes %>% count(gene_order, name = "replicates") %>% arrange(desc(replicates)) %>% knitr::kable(caption = "Gene order of the mean speed across replicates")
```

```{r fig-bootstrap, fig.width=12, fig.height=8}
forest <- function(st, xlab, title) {
  d <- ci %>% filter(stat == st, !is.na(main)) %>% mutate(traj_id = fct_reorder(traj_id, main))
  ggplot(d, aes(y = traj_id, x = main, xmin = lo, xmax = hi, color = gene, alpha = robust)) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
    geom_pointrange(size = 0.15, linewidth = 0.4) +
    scale_color_manual(values = gene_colors, name = "Gene") +
    scale_alpha_manual(values = c("TRUE" = 1, "FALSE" = 0.3), name = "Sign robust\n(>= 95% of replicates)") +
    labs(y = "Trajectory", x = xlab, title = title) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 13) + theme(axis.text.y = element_blank(), axis.ticks.y = element_blank(), panel.grid.minor = element_blank())
}
age_forest <- function(st, xlab, title) {
  d <- ci %>% filter(stat == st, !is.na(main)) %>% mutate(traj_id = fct_reorder(traj_id, main))
  ggplot(d, aes(y = traj_id, x = main, xmin = lo, xmax = hi, color = gene)) +
    geom_pointrange(size = 0.15, linewidth = 0.4) +
    scale_color_manual(values = gene_colors, name = "Gene") +
    labs(y = "Trajectory", x = xlab, title = title) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 13) + theme(axis.text.y = element_blank(), axis.ticks.y = element_blank(), panel.grid.minor = element_blank())
}
p_boot <- (forest("mean_VAF_speed", "mean VAF speed (per year), 95% bootstrap interval", "a. Mean VAF speed") |
           forest("mean_VAF_acceleration", "mean VAF acceleration (per year^2), 95% bootstrap interval", "b. Mean VAF acceleration")) /
  (age_forest("Age_0.02", "age at 2% VAF (years), 95% bootstrap interval", "c. Age at 2% VAF") |
   age_forest("Age_LoD2", "age at LoD/2 (years), 95% bootstrap interval", "d. Age at LoD/2 (extrapolated)")) +
  plot_layout(guides = "collect") & theme(legend.position = "right")
save_extra(p_boot, "bootstrap_intervals", 12, 8)
p_boot
```

# 4. Value of the not detected timepoints

In the main analysis a not detected timepoint has half the LoD of the timepoint. Alternatives: 0,
LoD/4, the LoD, and the timepoint removed. A trajectory with fewer than 3 points
left cannot be smoothed. The per-trajectory agreement is computed on the trajectories a scenario changes.

```{r imputation}
scenarios <- c("0", "LoD/4", "LoD", "without non-detected")
scenario_calls <- function(calls, scenario) {
  imputed_as <- function(f) calls %>% mutate(AF = ifelse(source == "imputed", f * lod_vaf, AF))
  switch(scenario, "0" = imputed_as(0), "LoD/4" = imputed_as(0.25), "LoD" = imputed_as(1),
         "without non-detected" = calls %>% filter(source != "imputed"))
}
affected_by <- function(sc) calls %>%
  left_join(sc %>% select(traj_id, Age, AF_sc = AF), by = c("traj_id", "Age")) %>%
  filter(is.na(AF_sc) | abs(AF_sc - AF) > 1e-12) %>% pull(traj_id) %>% unique()
res_D <- lapply(scenarios, function(s) {
  sc <- scenario_calls(calls, s)
  keep <- sc %>% count(traj_id) %>% filter(n >= 3) %>% pull(traj_id)
  r <- run_setting(spec_main, calls_in = sc %>% filter(traj_id %in% keep))
  r$affected <- affected_by(sc)
  r$lost <- setdiff(traj_ids, keep)
  r
}) %>% set_names(scenarios)
stopifnot(all(map_lgl(res_D, ~ !is.null(.x$sum))))
cmp_D <- map_dfr(scenarios, ~ compare_results(res_D[[.x]], main, subset = res_D[[.x]]$affected) %>%
                   mutate(setting = .x, `trajectories changed` = length(res_D[[.x]]$affected), `trajectories lost` = length(res_D[[.x]]$lost), .before = 1))
imput_tab <- bind_rows(tibble(setting = "LoD/2 (main)", `trajectories changed` = 0L, `trajectories lost` = 0L, `gene order` = main$gene_order, `same gene order` = TRUE,
                              `Fabre r` = main$fabre$r, `Fabre p` = main$fabre$p, `cluster ARI` = 1, `same sign, mean speed` = 1, `same sign, mean acceleration` = 1),
                       cmp_D) %>%
  select(setting, `trajectories changed`, `trajectories lost`, any_of(result_cols), starts_with("rho ")) %>%
  mutate(`clusters: seeds` = n_seeds_cl)
write_res(imput_tab, "imputation_sensitivity.txt")
imput_tab %>% select(-starts_with("rho ")) %>% knitr::kable(digits = 3, caption = "Results of the paper by value of the not detected timepoints")
```

```{r fig-imputation, fig.width=11, fig.height=5}
p_imp_heat <- rho_heat(rho_long(cmp_D, "setting") %>% mutate(setting = factor(setting, levels = scenarios)), "setting")
imp_long <- imput_tab %>%
  transmute(setting = factor(setting, levels = c("LoD/2 (main)", scenarios)), `Fabre r` = `Fabre r`, `cluster ARI` = `cluster ARI`,
            `same sign of\nmean speed` = `same sign, mean speed`, `same sign of\nmean acceleration` = `same sign, mean acceleration`) %>%
  pivot_longer(-setting, names_to = "quantity", values_to = "value") %>%
  mutate(quantity = fct_inorder(quantity))
p_imp_bars <- ggplot(imp_long, aes(x = setting, y = value, fill = setting == "LoD/2 (main)")) +
  geom_col(width = 0.7, colour = "grey30", linewidth = 0.2) +
  geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.2f", value)), angle = 90, hjust = -0.15, size = 2.5) +
  facet_wrap(~quantity, nrow = 1) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("TRUE" = reml_col, "FALSE" = "grey80"), guide = "none") +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1.35), breaks = c(0, 0.5, 1)) +
  labs(x = "Value of the not detected timepoints", y = NULL) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 13) + theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1), strip.background = element_blank())
p_imp <- (p_imp_heat | p_imp_bars) + plot_layout(widths = c(1, 1.2)) + plot_annotation(tag_levels = "a") & tag_theme
save_extra(p_imp, "imputation_sensitivity", 11, 5)
p_imp
```

# 5. The cross-sectional screening calls

The calls of the earlier cross-sectional screening assay inserted into the trajectories
(`resources/LoD/cross_sectional/chip_calls_long_filtered.txt`), fitted with REML and with `spar` = 0.2,
against the main analysis (agreement on the trajectories that gain a point). The file is not part of this
repository; the section runs only if that file is present.

```{r cross, eval = file.exists(file.path(rev$cross_resources, "chip_calls_long_filtered.txt"))}
calls_cross <- read_tsv_(file.path(rev$cross_resources, "chip_calls_long_filtered.txt")) %>%
  inner_join(ids, by = "ID") %>%
  mutate(source = factor(source, levels = names(source_shapes)))
lod_cross <- calls_cross %>% distinct(traj_id, lod = traj_lod_mean)
gain_point <- intersect(calls_cross$traj_id[calls_cross$type == "cross"], traj_ids)
res_E <- list(`REML + cross-sectional calls` = run_setting(spec_main, calls_in = calls_cross, lod = lod_cross),
              `spar 0.2 + cross-sectional calls` = run_setting(spec_grid[["spar 0.2"]], calls_in = calls_cross, lod = lod_cross))
cmp_E <- imap_dfr(res_E, ~ compare_results(.x, main, subset = gain_point) %>% mutate(setting = .y, .before = 1))
cmp_E %>% select(any_of(result_cols)) %>% knitr::kable(digits = 3, caption = sprintf("With the cross-sectional calls (%d trajectories gain a point; agreement on those)", length(gain_point)))
```

# 6. Simulation: what the design identifies

Clones with a constant fitness *s* are simulated (logistic growth of the clone fraction with genetic drift, binomial
sequencing noise), from a VAF of 1% at age 52 for 20
years, sequenced at depth 2,000 with the median LoD of the study (0.28%; a timepoint without a variant read is set to
LoD/2, as in SHCS), and re-fitted from the measured VAF sampled every 1, 2, 3 or 5 years with the REML spline of the
main analysis and with the `spar` = 0.2 spline. The reference of each trajectory is the REML spline fitted to its
true (noise-free) VAF of every year; the errors of the mean speed and the mean acceleration are taken over the ages the
fit covers.

```{r sim-functions}
# The simulation model: Moran drift on the logit scale when the clone has many lineages, a Poisson-Gamma birth-death
# step when it is rare, binomial reads.
growth_up <- function(s, dt) if (s == 0) dt else expm1(s * dt) / s
growth_down <- function(s, dt) if (s == 0) dt else -expm1(-s * dt) / s
lineage_scale <- function(s, dt, N_tau) growth_up(s, dt) / N_tau
n_lineages <- function(x, s, dt, N_tau) x * exp(s * dt) / lineage_scale(s, dt, N_tau)
rare_step <- function(x, s, dt, N_tau) {
  K <- rpois(1, n_lineages(x, s, dt, N_tau))
  if (K == 0) 0 else rgamma(1, K, scale = lineage_scale(s, dt, N_tau))
}
next_x <- function(x, s, N_tau, dt = 1, min_lineages = 100) {
  if (x <= 0 || x >= 1) return(x)
  if (n_lineages(x, s, dt, N_tau) < min_lineages) return(min(rare_step(x, s, dt, N_tau), 1))
  if (n_lineages(1 - x, -s, dt, N_tau) < min_lineages) return(max(1 - rare_step(1 - x, -s, dt, N_tau), 0))
  o <- x / (1 - x)
  A <- growth_down(s, dt) / o
  B <- o * growth_up(s, dt)
  plogis(rnorm(1, qlogis(x) + s * dt + (B - A) / N_tau, sqrt(2 * (A + 2 * dt + B) / N_tau)))
}
simulate_trajectory <- function(vaf0, s, years = 20, N_tau = 1e5) {
  stopifnot(vaf0 >= 0, vaf0 <= 0.5)
  x <- numeric(years + 1)
  x[1] <- 2 * vaf0
  for (i in seq_len(years)) x[i + 1] <- next_x(x[i], s, N_tau)
  tibble(year = 0:years, VAF = x / 2)
}
add_reads <- function(d, depth = 2000) mutate(d, alt_reads = rbinom(n(), depth, VAF), VAF_obs = alt_reads / depth)
logistic_vaf <- function(vaf0, s, year) plogis(qlogis(2 * vaf0) + s * year) / 2
```

```{r sim-trajectories}
vaf0 <- 0.01
s_grid <- c(0, 0.01, 0.025, 0.05, 0.1, 0.15, 0.2, 0.3, 0.5)
n_rep <- if (quick) 4 else 100
years <- 20
N_tau <- 1e5
depth <- 2000
start_age <- 52
lod_sim <- 0.0028
every_grid <- c(1, 2, 3, 5)
every_names <- setNames(ifelse(every_grid == 1, "every year", paste("every", every_grid, "years")), every_grid)

# 10 trajectories per s with seed 1, then 90 more with seed 2
set.seed(1)
traj_1 <- expand_grid(s = s_grid, rep = seq_len(min(10, n_rep))) %>%
  mutate(traj = map(s, ~ simulate_trajectory(vaf0, .x, years, N_tau))) %>% unnest(traj) %>% add_reads(depth)
set.seed(2)
traj_2 <- if (n_rep > 10) expand_grid(s = s_grid, rep = seq_len(n_rep)) %>% filter(rep > 10) %>%
  mutate(traj = map(s, ~ simulate_trajectory(vaf0, .x, years, N_tau))) %>% unnest(traj) %>% add_reads(depth) else NULL
sim <- bind_rows(traj_1, traj_2) %>%
  mutate(traj_id = paste(s, rep, sep = "_"), Age = start_age + year, AF_true = VAF,
         AF_meas = ifelse(alt_reads == 0, lod_sim / 2, VAF_obs))
sim_ids <- sim %>% distinct(traj_id, s, rep)
cat(nrow(sim_ids), "simulated trajectories;", sum(sim$year == years & sim$VAF == 0), "lost by year 20\n")
```

```{r sim-fits}
# one fit: curve every 0.5 years within the fitted ages, mean speed and mean acceleration; NULL if it cannot be fitted
fit_one <- function(age, af, spec) {
  f <- fit_traj(age, af, spec)
  if (is.null(f)) return(NULL)
  spline_curves(f$predict, curve_ages(age, f$predict, FALSE)) %>% mutate(df = f$df)
}
curve_stats <- function(cv) tibble(mean_speed = mean(cv$VAF_speed), mean_acc = mean(cv$VAF_acceleration), max_speed = max(cv$VAF_speed),
                                   max_VAF = max(cv$VAF), min_Age = min(cv$Age), max_Age = max(cv$Age), df = cv$df[1])
sim_split <- split(sim, sim$traj_id)
spec_spar <- spec_grid[["spar 0.2"]]

# reference: REML on the true VAF of every year
ref_curves <- parallel::mclapply(names(sim_split), function(id) {
  d <- sim_split[[id]]
  fit_one(d$Age, d$AF_true, spec_main) %>% mutate(traj_id = id)
}, mc.cores = n_cores) %>% bind_rows()
ref_stats <- ref_curves %>% group_by(traj_id) %>% group_modify(~ curve_stats(.x)) %>% ungroup()
ref_within <- function(id, lo, hi) {   # reference statistics over the ages a fit covers
  r <- ref_curves[ref_curves$traj_id == id & ref_curves$Age >= lo - 1e-9 & ref_curves$Age <= hi + 1e-9, ]
  c(ref_speed = mean(r$VAF_speed), ref_acc = mean(r$VAF_acceleration))
}

# the fits of the measured VAF: every interval x both splines
fit_grid <- expand_grid(every = every_grid, spline = c("REML", "spar 0.2"))
sim_fits <- parallel::mclapply(names(sim_split), function(id) {
  d <- sim_split[[id]]
  pmap_dfr(fit_grid, function(every, spline) {
    dd <- d[d$year %% every == 0, ]
    cv <- fit_one(dd$Age, dd$AF_meas, if (spline == "REML") spec_main else spec_spar)
    if (is.null(cv)) return(NULL)
    st <- curve_stats(cv)
    rw <- ref_within(id, st$min_Age, st$max_Age)
    bind_cols(tibble(traj_id = id, every = every, spline = spline), st, as_tibble(as.list(rw)))
  })
}, mc.cores = n_cores) %>% bind_rows() %>% left_join(sim_ids, by = "traj_id")

sim_errors <- sim_fits %>%
  group_by(s, every, spline) %>%
  summarise(trajectories = n(),
            `median relative error of mean speed` = median(abs(mean_speed - ref_speed)[ref_speed > 0] / ref_speed[ref_speed > 0]),
            `median absolute error of mean speed` = median(abs(mean_speed - ref_speed)),
            `Spearman rho of mean speed` = suppressWarnings(cor(mean_speed, ref_speed, method = "spearman")),
            `same sign of mean speed` = mean(sign(mean_speed) == sign(ref_speed)),
            `median absolute error of mean acceleration` = median(abs(mean_acc - ref_acc)),
            `median |reference mean acceleration|` = median(abs(ref_acc)),
            `Spearman rho of mean acceleration` = suppressWarnings(cor(mean_acc, ref_acc, method = "spearman")),
            `same sign of mean acceleration` = mean(sign(mean_acc) == sign(ref_acc)),
            `median effective df` = median(df), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(sampling = every_names[as.character(every)], .after = every)
sim_pooled <- sim_fits %>%
  filter(s > 0) %>%
  group_by(every, spline) %>%
  summarise(trajectories = n(),
            `Spearman rho of mean speed, all s pooled` = cor(mean_speed, ref_speed, method = "spearman"),
            `Spearman rho of mean acceleration, all s pooled` = cor(mean_acc, ref_acc, method = "spearman"),
            `same sign of mean speed` = mean(sign(mean_speed) == sign(ref_speed)),
            `same sign of mean acceleration` = mean(sign(mean_acc) == sign(ref_acc)),
            `median relative error of mean speed` = median(abs(mean_speed - ref_speed)[ref_speed > 0] / ref_speed[ref_speed > 0]),
            `median relative error of mean acceleration` = median(abs(mean_acc - ref_acc)[ref_acc > 0] / ref_acc[ref_acc > 0]), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(sampling = every_names[as.character(every)], .after = every)
sim_errors <- sim_errors %>%
  left_join(sim_fits %>% group_by(s, every, spline) %>%
              summarise(`median relative error of mean acceleration` = median(abs(mean_acc - ref_acc)[ref_acc > 0] / ref_acc[ref_acc > 0]), .groups = "drop"),
            by = c("s", "every", "spline"))
write_res(sim_errors, "simulation_REML_errors.txt")
write_res(sim_pooled, "simulation_REML_pooled.txt")
knitr::kable(sim_pooled, digits = 3, caption = "All fitness values pooled (s > 0): the fitted against the reference statistics across the trajectories")
sim_errors %>% filter(every == 5) %>% select(s, spline, `median relative error of mean speed`, `Spearman rho of mean speed`, `same sign of mean speed`,
                                             `median absolute error of mean acceleration`, `median relative error of mean acceleration`, `Spearman rho of mean acceleration`, `same sign of mean acceleration`) %>%
  knitr::kable(digits = 3, caption = "Sampling every 5 years: recovery of the mean speed and the mean acceleration")
sim_errors %>% filter(spline == "REML") %>% select(s, sampling, `median relative error of mean speed`, `Spearman rho of mean speed`, `Spearman rho of mean acceleration`) %>%
  knitr::kable(digits = 3, caption = "REML spline by sampling interval")
```

```{r fig-simulation, fig.width=13, fig.height=10}
# a. the first trajectory of each s: measured points, REML fit to every year (black) and every 5 years (red)
first_ids <- sim_ids %>% filter(rep == 1) %>% pull(traj_id)
panel_curves <- parallel::mclapply(first_ids, function(id) {
  d <- sim_split[[id]]
  bind_rows(fit_one(d$Age, d$AF_meas, spec_main) %>% mutate(fit = "every year"),
            fit_one(d$Age[d$year %% 5 == 0], d$AF_meas[d$year %% 5 == 0], spec_main) %>% mutate(fit = "every 5 years")) %>%
    mutate(traj_id = id)
}, mc.cores = n_cores) %>% bind_rows() %>% left_join(sim_ids, by = "traj_id")
measure_levels <- c(VAF = "VAF", VAF_speed = "Speed\n(VAF / year)", VAF_acceleration = "Acceleration\n(VAF / year^2)")
pc <- panel_curves %>%
  pivot_longer(c(VAF, VAF_speed, VAF_acceleration), names_to = "measure", values_to = "value") %>%
  mutate(measure = factor(measure_levels[measure], levels = measure_levels), s_lab = factor(paste("s =", s), levels = paste("s =", s_grid)),
         fit = factor(fit, levels = c("every year", "every 5 years")))
pts <- sim %>% filter(rep == 1) %>%
  transmute(s_lab = factor(paste("s =", s), levels = paste("s =", s_grid)), Age, value = AF_meas, measure = factor(measure_levels[["VAF"]], levels = measure_levels),
            sampled = year %% 5 == 0)
p_a <- ggplot(pc, aes(x = Age - start_age, y = value)) +
  geom_point(data = pts, aes(alpha = sampled), colour = "grey40", size = 1.1) +
  geom_line(aes(colour = fit, linewidth = fit)) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("every year" = "black", "every 5 years" = reml_col), name = "REML fit to the points") +
  scale_linewidth_manual(values = c("every year" = 1.1, "every 5 years" = 0.8), name = "REML fit to the points") +
  scale_alpha_manual(values = c("TRUE" = 1, "FALSE" = 0.35), labels = c("TRUE" = "every 5 years", "FALSE" = "other years"), name = "Measured VAF") +
  facet_grid(measure ~ s_lab, scales = "free_y", switch = "y") +
  labs(x = "Years since the start (age 52)", y = NULL) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) + theme(strip.placement = "outside", strip.background = element_blank(), legend.position = "top", axis.text = element_text(size = 7),
                                   strip.text.y.left = element_text(angle = 90))

# b. fitted against reference mean speed, 5-year sampling
s_colors <- setNames(colorRampPalette(c("#86b6ef", "#0d366b"))(length(s_grid)), s_grid)
p_b <- sim_fits %>% filter(every == 5, spline == "REML") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = ref_speed, y = mean_speed, colour = factor(s))) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey50") +
  geom_point(size = 0.8, alpha = 0.7) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(0, 0.01, 0.02)) + scale_y_continuous(breaks = c(0, 0.01, 0.02)) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = s_colors, name = "s (per year)") +
  labs(x = "Reference mean speed\n(REML on the true VAF of every year)", y = "Fitted mean speed, sampling every 5 years") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) + theme(strip.background = element_blank())

# c, d. errors by s and sampling interval
err_long <- sim_errors %>% filter(s > 0, spline == "REML") %>%
  mutate(sampling = factor(sampling, levels = every_names))
p_c <- ggplot(err_long, aes(x = s, y = `median relative error of mean speed`, colour = sampling)) +
  geom_line() + geom_point(size = 1.2) +
```

# 7. Overview of the sensitivity analyses

```{r overview}
pick <- function(cmp, analysis) cmp %>%
  transmute(analysis, setting, `trajectories compared` = trajectories, `gene order` = `gene order`, `same gene order` = `same gene order`,
            `Fabre r` = `Fabre r`, `Fabre p` = `Fabre p`, `cluster ARI` = `cluster ARI`,
            `same sign, mean speed` = `same sign, mean speed`, `same sign, mean acceleration` = `same sign, mean acceleration`,
            `rho mean speed` = `rho mean_VAF_speed`, `rho max VAF` = `rho max_VAF`, `rho mean acceleration` = `rho mean_VAF_acceleration`,
            `rho age at 2% VAF` = `rho Age_0.02`)
overview <- bind_rows(
  tibble(analysis = "main analysis", setting = "REML, not detected at LoD/2, longitudinal assay", `trajectories compared` = length(traj_ids),
         `gene order` = main$gene_order, `same gene order` = TRUE, `Fabre r` = main$fabre$r, `Fabre p` = main$fabre$p, `cluster ARI` = 1,
         `same sign, mean speed` = 1, `same sign, mean acceleration` = 1, `rho mean speed` = 1, `rho max VAF` = 1, `rho mean acceleration` = 1, `rho age at 2% VAF` = 1),
  pick(cmp_A, "spline setting"),
  pick(cmp_D, "value of the not detected timepoints") %>% mutate(setting = paste("not detected at", setting)),
  if (exists("cmp_E")) pick(cmp_E, "cross-sectional screening calls"),
  tibble(analysis = "read-count bootstrap", setting = sprintf("%d replicates", B_boot), `trajectories compared` = length(traj_ids),
         `gene order` = sprintf("main order in %.0f%% of replicates", 100 * boot_summary$`replicates with the main gene order`),
         `same gene order` = boot_summary$`replicates with the main gene order` >= 0.5,
         `Fabre r` = boot_summary$`Fabre r, median`, `Fabre p` = NA_real_, `cluster ARI` = NA_real_,
         `same sign, mean speed` = boot_summary$`mean speed: robust sign`, `same sign, mean acceleration` = boot_summary$`mean acceleration: robust sign`,
         `rho mean speed` = NA_real_, `rho max VAF` = NA_real_, `rho mean acceleration` = NA_real_, `rho age at 2% VAF` = NA_real_)) %>%
  mutate(note = case_when(analysis == "read-count bootstrap" ~ "same sign = share of trajectories whose sign holds in >= 95% of replicates; Fabre r = median over replicates",
                          analysis == "value of the not detected timepoints" ~ "agreement computed on the trajectories the scenario changes",
                          analysis == "cross-sectional screening calls" ~ "agreement computed on the trajectories that gain a point",
                          TRUE ~ ""))
write_res(overview, "sensitivity_overview.txt")
overview %>% select(-note) %>% knitr::kable(digits = 3, caption = "Overview of the sensitivity analyses against the main analysis")
```
